meta.name: init-first-agent
meta.description: Walk the operator through creating the first NanoClaw agent for a DM channel — resolve the operator's channel identity, wire the DM messaging group to a new agent, and trigger a welcome DM via the normal delivery path. Use after channel credentials are configured and the service is running.

copy.tagline: 引导创建首个智能体并配置消息通道
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要快速搭建并测试第一个智能体机器人。
copy.tagline_en: Guide through creating the first agent and configuring messaging channels

howto.what: 引导你逐步创建第一个NanoClaw agent：选择频道、提供你的用户ID和显示名称、解析平台ID，然后运行脚本创建agent并发送欢迎DM。最后确认你是否收到消息。
howto.when: 在频道凭证已配置且服务运行后，当你要求创建第一个agent时触发。

say.text: 帮我在Discord上创建第一个NanoClaw agent。

howto.what_en: Guides you step-by-step to create your first NanoClaw agent: pick a channel, provide your user ID and display name, resolve the DM platform ID, then run a script that creates the agent and sends a welcome DM. Finally, asks if you received it.
howto.when_en: Triggers after channel credentials are configured and the service is running, when you ask to create the first agent.

say_en.text: Set up my first NanoClaw agent on Discord.
Initialize the first agent for me.
